key_highlights: ASX logged a third consecutive week of gains, propelled by robust rallies in miners and technology stocks.
Australian unemployment surged to a five-year high, abruptly tempering RBA interest rate hike expectations.
The Australian dollar faced heavy selling pressure following the weak labor market print.
Sydney auction clearance rates and property market metrics signal mounting stress in residential real estate.
Resource sector buoyed by gold exploration discoveries and large-scale lithium expansion announcements.

sectors.trend: Resources led market gains amid strong gold discoveries, fast-tracked production, and tier-one lithium mine expansions.
sectors.implications: Strong operational momentum favors gold and copper miners; low-cost producers remain resilient against global trade risks.

sectors.trend: Rising unemployment and deteriorating auction clearance rates create headwinds for mortgage credit growth and asset quality.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin expansion has peaked; credit impairment risks may dampen major bank valuations despite reduced rate hike pressure.

sectors.trend: Technology shares advanced in tandem with resources as easing interest rate expectations lowered discount rates.
sectors.implications: Valuation multiples across high-growth software and platform businesses receive short-term support.

sectors.trend: Persistent domestic gas supply constraints and international conflict maintain elevated wholesale volatility.
sectors.implications: Defensive cash generation persists for integrated LNG operators, while domestic policy scrutiny on domestic reservation grows.

sectors.trend: Auction weakness and rising residential stress weigh on broader property sentiment.
sectors.implications: Sellers face liquidity constraints; prefer commercial and industrial asset owners over leveraged residential developers.

key_themes: Labor market deterioration dampening RBA tightening bias while elevating macro slowdown risks
Divergence between strong equity index momentum and weakening domestic economic fundamentals
AUD weakness providing earnings tailwinds to offshore earners while pressuring imported inflation
Global supply chain shifts and 'China Shock 2.0' trade friction impacting commodity demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Labor Market Deterioration and Consumer Retrenchment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical consumer discretionary; favor defensive consumer staples and non-cyclical healthcare.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Residential Property and Mortgage Credit Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to retail-heavy domestic banks and debt-laden property developers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China Industrial Overcapacity and Export Flooding (China Shock 2.0)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight lowest-quartile cash cost mining producers with robust balance sheets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA Policy Impasse Between High Inflation and Weakening Growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain allocations in inflation-linked securities, infrastructure, and defensive high-yield assets.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Diversified Mining Majors
opportunities.rationale: High AUD gold prices, strong project pipelines, and currency depreciation enhance operating cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Re-entry into High-Quality Technology Growth
opportunities.rationale: Subsiding rate hike expectations alleviate valuation headwinds for established market leaders.
Scale expansion projects position world-class lithium producers for long-term structural demand.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Major Domestic Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising unemployment and cooling property clearances heighten loan impairment and credit growth risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Allocate to Defensive Global Earners and Healthcare
defensive_moves.rationale: Earnings generated in foreign currencies benefit from a declining AUD, providing downside protection.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX trading as strength in resource and technology heavyweights counters mounting domestic macro and housing headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Equities supported by defensive resource exporters and eventual RBA rate cuts, though cyclical domestic sectors face ongoing earnings pressure.
key_catalysts: Next RBA monetary policy meeting and cash rate decision
Quarterly Australian CPI and updated wage price index releases
Chinese macroeconomic policy measures and stimulus execution
Australian major banks' quarterly trading updates and impairment provisioning
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe spot pricing and gold bullion spot in AUD
Capital city auction clearance rates and delinquency trends
Monthly employment change and underemployment figures
